title: CALL ON ME
IN DISTRESS
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight
stock_queries: deep starry night sky over forest
glowing solitary prayer candle in dark
silhouette of an ancient stone watchtower
rippling reflection of moon on dark lake
soft candlelight illuminating a wooden table
distant galaxy in velvet night sky

scenes.a: That persistent weight in your chest is precisely why you were drawn here tonight.
Call upon me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you shall glorify me.
Lord, in this deep silence, I bring the heavy burdens that have kept me awake.
You see every anxious thought and every unspoken fear that shadows this quiet room.
I surrender my need for control and trust in your promise to be my refuge.
May your peace steady my heart as I commit this coming day into your hands.
